technical_steps_en: 🚨 IMMEDIATELY turn on Airplane Mode — this cuts the attacker's connection right now.
🔴 Power off the phone completely.
⚠️ Do NOT use this phone for any passwords or banking until cleaned.
📱 Switch to a borrowed safe device to continue this conversation.
🔐 From the safe device: Change your Google/Apple ID password first.
🔑 Enable 2FA on all accounts.
📞 Contact your mobile carrier to check for SIM-swap (Airtel: 0800 110 011, Vodacom: 100, Tigo: 0800 750 075).
🛡️ Boot into Safe Mode and uninstall suspicious apps when safe.
🔄 Last resort: Factory reset (back up important data first if possible).
technical_steps_sw: 🚨 MARA MOJA washa Airplane Mode ili kukata muunganisho wa mshambuliaji.
🔴 Zima simu yako kabisa.
⚠️ Usitumie simu hii kwa nywila au benki mpaka iwe salama.
📱 Badilisha kwenye simu ya rafiki au kompyuta kuendelea.
🔐 Badilisha nywila ya Google/Apple ID kwanza kutoka kifaa salama.
🔑 Washa 2FA kwenye akaunti zote.
📞 Piga simu mtoa huduma wako kuhusu SIM-swap.
🛡️ Ingia Safe Mode na ondoa programu za kutia shaka.
🔄 Suluhisho la mwisho: Rudisha simu kiwandani.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Having your device taken over feels like a serious violation. Your fear is valid. You are regaining control now.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Kudhibitiwa kwa simu yako ni ukiukaji mkubwa. Hofu yako ni halali. Unachukua udhibiti sasa.

technical_steps_en: 📞 Call Airtel Money customer care immediately: *100# or 0800 110 010
Report the fraud and request transaction reversal with the transaction ID.
Block the fraudster's number right away.
Change your Airtel Money PIN from a safe device.
Monitor your Airtel Money account for any further suspicious activity.
Save all SMS and call logs as evidence.
technical_steps_sw: 📞 Piga Airtel Money mara moja: *100# au 0800 110 010
Ripoti udanganyifu na omba kufuta muamala ukitumia transaction ID.
Zuia nambari ya mwizi mara moja.
Badilisha PIN yako ya Airtel Money kutoka kifaa salama.
Fuatilia akaunti yako ya Airtel Money kwa shughuli za kutia shaka.
Hifadhi SMS na rekodi za simu kama ushahidi.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Airtel Money scams are very common. You are not alone and you acted quickly.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Udanganyifu wa Airtel Money ni wa kawaida sana. Wewe si peke yako na ulichukua hatua haraka.

technical_steps_en: 📞 Dial *234# or call Safaricom 0800 724 000 immediately to report the fraud.
Provide the transaction ID, amount, and fraudster's number.
Request transaction reversal.
Block the number and change your M-Pesa PIN.
Save all evidence (SMS and call logs).
technical_steps_sw: 📞 Chagua *234# au piga 0800 724 000 mara moja kuripoti.
Toa transaction ID, kiasi, na nambari ya mwizi.
Omba kufuta muamala.
Zuia nambari na badilisha PIN ya M-Pesa.
Hifadhi ushahidi wote.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: M-Pesa scams are very common in Tanzania. Many people have recovered their money by acting fast.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Udanganyifu wa M-Pesa ni wa kawaida sana Tanzania. Watu wengi wamefanikiwa kurejesha pesa zao kwa kuchukua hatua haraka.

technical_steps_en: 📞 Dial *150# or call Tigo 0800 750 075 to report the fraud.
Provide transaction details and request reversal.
Block the fraudster and change your Tigo Pesa PIN.
technical_steps_sw: 📞 Chagua *150# au piga 0800 750 075 kuripoti.
Toa maelezo ya muamala na omba kufuta.
Zuia mwizi na badilisha PIN ya Tigo Pesa.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Tigo Pesa scams are increasing. Acting fast improves your chances of recovery.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Udanganyifu wa Tigo Pesa unaongezeka. Kuchukua hatua haraka huongeza nafasi ya kurejesha pesa.

technical_steps_en: 🔐 Try to recover your account immediately using the platform's official recovery page.
📧 For WhatsApp: Reinstall the app → verify with your phone number → this will log out anyone else.
📧 For Google/Gmail: Go to accounts.google.com/recovery and follow the steps.
📘 For Facebook: Use facebook.com/hacked to report and recover.
🔑 Once recovered: IMMEDIATELY change your password to something strong and unique.
✅ Enable 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) right away.
📞 Check 'Active Sessions' or 'Logged-in Devices' and log out all unknown devices.
👥 Warn your contacts that your account was compromised — scammers may have messaged them.
📋 Screenshot any suspicious messages or activity as evidence.
technical_steps_sw: 🔐 Jaribu kurejesha akaunti yako mara moja ukitumia ukurasa rasmi wa kurejesha wa jukwaa.
📧 Kwa WhatsApp: Sakinisha upya programu → thibitisha na nambari yako ya simu → hii itamtoa mtu yeyote mwingine.
📧 Kwa Google/Gmail: Nenda accounts.google.com/recovery na ufuate hatua.
📘 Kwa Facebook: Tumia facebook.com/hacked kuripoti na kurejesha.
🔑 Ukiisha kurejesha: MARA MOJA badilisha nywila yako kuwa kitu chenye nguvu na cha kipekee.
✅ Washa Uthibitishaji wa Hatua 2 (2FA) mara moja.
📞 Angalia 'Vikao Amilifu' au 'Vifaa Vilivyoingia' na toka kwenye vifaa vyote visivyojulikana.
👥 Onya mawasiliano yako kwamba akaunti yako iliathirika — walaghai wanaweza kuwaandikia.
📋 Piga picha za ujumbe wowote wa kutia shaka au shughuli kama ushahidi.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Having your account taken over can feel like losing a piece of your identity. The worry about what was said or done in your name is real and valid. You're doing the right thing by acting now.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Kuwa na akaunti yako iliyochukuliwa kunaweza kujihisi kama kupoteza sehemu ya utambulisho wako. Wasiwasi kuhusu kilichosemwa au kufanywa kwa jina lako ni wa kweli na halali. Unafanya jambo sahihi kwa kutenda sasa.

technical_steps_en: ✈️ Turn on Airplane Mode to prevent the malware from sending your data out.
🛡️ Boot into Safe Mode: Hold Power → long-press 'Power off' → tap 'Safe Mode'.
🔍 In Safe Mode: Go to Settings → Apps → look for apps you don't recognize or didn't install.
🗑️ Uninstall suspicious apps. If you can't uninstall, go to Settings → Accessibility → Installed services and disable anything suspicious.
🔒 Run Google Play Protect scan: Open Play Store → Menu → Play Protect → Scan.
🔐 Change all important passwords from a different, clean device.
🔄 If malware persists: Factory Reset is the safest option (Settings → General Management → Reset).
⬇️ After reset: Only reinstall apps from the official Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
🔑 Never install APK files from unknown sources.
technical_steps_sw: ✈️ Washa Hali ya Ndege kuzuia programu hasidi kutuma data yako.
🛡️ Ingia katika Hali Salama: Shikilia Nguvu → shikilia 'Zima nguvu' → gusa 'Hali Salama'.
🔍 Katika Hali Salama: Nenda Mipangilio → Programu → tafuta programu usizozijua au hukuzisakinisha.
🗑️ Ondoa programu za kutia shaka. Kama huwezi kuondoa, nenda Mipangilio → Ufikiaji → Huduma zilizosakinishwa na zima chochote cha kutia shaka.
🔒 Endesha skana ya Google Play Protect: Fungua Duka la Play → Menyu → Play Protect → Skana.
🔐 Badilisha nywila zote muhimu kutoka kwenye kifaa kingine safi.
🔄 Kama programu hasidi inaendelea: Rudisha Mipangilio ya Kiwanda ndiyo chaguo salama zaidi.
⬇️ Baada ya kuweka upya: Sakinisha programu tu kutoka kwenye Duka rasmi la Google Play au Apple App Store.
🔑 Usiwahi kusakinisha faili za APK kutoka vyanzo visivyojulikana.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Discovering malware on your device is alarming and violating. The uncertainty of not knowing what was accessed or stolen is genuinely stressful. You are in control now — these steps will protect you.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Kugundua programu hasidi kwenye kifaa chako ni jambo la kutisha na la ukiukaji. Kutojua nini kilifikiliwa au kilibiwa ni msongo wa kweli. Uko na udhibiti sasa — hatua hizi zitakulinda.

technical_steps_en: 🔍 Check if your email was in a breach: Visit haveibeenpwned.com and enter your email.
🔑 Change passwords for all accounts that used the same password as the breached service — IMMEDIATELY.
✅ Enable 2FA on all important accounts.
💳 If financial data was exposed: Contact your bank fraud line immediately and request a card freeze or replacement.
🪪 If National ID was exposed: Contact NIDA Tanzania (0800 780 004) to report potential identity fraud.
📧 Watch for phishing emails or calls pretending to be from services you use.
🔒 Consider using a password manager going forward.
technical_steps_sw: 🔍 Angalia kama barua pepe yako ilikuwa katika uvunjaji: Tembelea haveibeenpwned.com na ingiza barua pepe yako.
🔑 Badilisha nywila kwa akaunti zote zilizotumia nywila ile ile kama huduma iliyovunjwa — MARA MOJA.
✅ Washa 2FA kwenye akaunti zote muhimu.
💳 Kama data ya fedha ilifichuliwa: Wasiliana na mstari wa udanganyifu wa benki yako mara moja na omba kufungia au kubadilisha kadi.
🪪 Kama Kitambulisho cha Taifa kilifichuliwa: Wasiliana na NIDA Tanzania (0800 780 004) kuripoti udanganyifu wa utambulisho.
📧 Angalia barua pepe za udanganyifu au simu zinazojidhihirisha kuwa ni huduma unazotumia.
🔒 Fikiria kutumia kidhibiti nywila kuendelea.
incident_types.emotional_note_en: Learning your data was breached feels like a loss of control over your own story. It's unsettling not knowing who has your information. These steps will help you regain control one piece at a time.
incident_types.emotional_note_sw: Kujua kwamba data yako ilivunjwa kunajihisi kama kupoteza udhibiti wa hadithi yako mwenyewe. Ni jambo la kutia wasiwasi kutokujua nani ana taarifa zako. Hatua hizi zitakusaidia kupata tena udhibiti kidogo kidogo.

tzcert.name_sw: TZ-CERT (Timu ya Kujibu Dharura ya Kompyuta ya Tanzania)
tzcert.instructions_en: Go to https://www.tzcert.go.tz/incident/report, copy the details below into each matching field, then click Submit.
tzcert.instructions_sw: Nenda https://www.tzcert.go.tz/incident/report, nakili maelezo yaliyo hapa chini kwenye kila uwanja unaofanana, kisha bonyeza Wasilisha.

police.name_sw: Polisi wa Tanzania / Kitengo cha Uhalifu wa Mtandao
police.contact_en: Nearest police station or call 112 (emergency) / +255 22 211 7507 (Cybercrime Unit Dar es Salaam)
police.contact_sw: Kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu au piga simu 112 (dharura) / +255 22 211 7507 (Kitengo cha Uhalifu wa Mtandao Dar es Salaam)
police.instructions_en: Use the statement template below at your nearest police station or email to the Cybercrime Unit.
police.instructions_sw: Tumia kiolezo cha taarifa hapa chini katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu nawe au tuma barua pepe kwa Kitengo cha Uhalifu wa Mtandao.

mobile_money_provider.name_sw: Mstari wa Udanganyifu wa Mtoa Pesa za Simu
mobile_money_provider.contacts_en: M-Pesa/Safaricom: *234# or 0800 724 000 | Airtel Money: *100# or 0800 110 010 | Tigo Pesa: *150# or 0800 750 075
mobile_money_provider.contacts_sw: M-Pesa/Safaricom: *234# au 0800 724 000 | Airtel Money: *100# au 0800 110 010 | Tigo Pesa: *150# au 0800 750 075
mobile_money_provider.instructions_en: Call or dial the USSD code above. Report the fraud, provide the transaction ID from your SMS, and request a reversal.
mobile_money_provider.instructions_sw: Piga simu au chagua nambari ya USSD hapo juu. Ripoti udanganyifu, toa kitambulisho cha muamala kutoka SMS yako, na omba kufuta.

platform_report.links_sw: WhatsApp: Mipangilio → Msaada → Wasiliana Nasi | Facebook: facebook.com/hacked | Instagram: instagram.com/hacked | Google: accounts.google.com/recovery
platform_report.instructions_en: Use the platform's official recovery/report page above to report and recover your account.
platform_report.instructions_sw: Tumia ukurasa rasmi wa kurejesha/kuripoti wa jukwaa hapo juu kuripoti na kurejesha akaunti yako.
